selection_rule: Include all five deterministic route mismatches, one case from each of the six high-risk families, and four correctly routed control strata.
review_questions: Does the frozen expected route follow the preregistered policy?
Does the recorded candidate decision match the raw agent output?
Does any result bypass the high-risk mandatory floor?
Are positions 15, 48, 56, 59, and 67 correctly characterized as advisory naming mismatches rather than task-class or activation failures?
Do the exploratory results justify preparing a corrected, newly approved R0 rerun?
